thaumictinkerer.configuration.kami_enabl: Set to true to enable all kami content.
thaumictinkerer.configuration.imbued_fir: Set to false to disable imbued fire.
Set to false to disable imbued fire making cake. For those people who don't like cake.
thaumictinkerer.configuration.share_tome: Set to false to disable the crafting recipe for the Tome of Research Sharing.
thaumictinkerer.configuration.crops_allo: Allows crops to be grown using bonemeal. Useful for debug purposes.
thaumictinkerer.configuration.mod_flight: Set to true to enable flight in this mod.
thaumictinkerer.configuration.placement_: Set to false to remove the phantom blocks displayed by the Worldshaper's Seeing Glass.
thaumictinkerer.configuration.tooltip_in: Set to false to disable the [TT] tooltips in the Thaumonomicon.
